rows.decision: Personal, Base and Test use Authorization Bearer only; Service uses Authorization plus X-Client-Secret; both header values and token-derived payloads are forbidden in every sink

401 covers failed token or service-secret verification; 403 covers category/access/type mismatch, missing or mismatched service secret, wrong service token, and X-Client-Secret forbidden with a personal token; tests use synthetic canaries only
Log method, exact classified host and controlled route template; never raw path or object ID fallback
Full URL, query, URL credentials, raw path and all object IDs are forbidden across API and worker sinks
Current FBS and stock endpoints document 402; emit payment_required with status only and no WB body
406 applies to the WMS stock update route and maps to operation_blocked without WB body
451 is documented for moderated files in User Communication, outside the current content, marketplace and supplies call inventory; unknown future 4xx still use generic http_rejected without body
Cover 2xx, 3xx, 400, 401, 403, 404, 409, 413, 422, 429, 5xx and no-response with typed outcomes and no body
No-response failures use a closed error_type enum without exception text or request repr
Service limits aggregate across all tokens of one service; Base and Test have lower limits aggregated within token type; logging records no token identity

Remaining is expected absent on 429; Retry, Limit and Reset are parsed as non-negative numeric seconds/counts; absent, negative, overflow or malformed values become null and raw strings are not logged
One event per wire attempt with stable operation_ref, unique request_ref and bounded attempt count
One event per page/batch HTTP attempt; cursors, object IDs and partial response bodies are never logged
SGTIN/CIS, UIN, IMEI, GTIN, barcode, sticker, QR, ZPL, PDF and image canaries are absent from every success/error sink

Aggregate and scan structured WB events, log_wb_client_error, app/httpx/httpcore/access logs, API exception output, worker task/retry/failure logs, traces, metric labels and test evidence; zero raw canary matches and one event per attempt
MockTransport/local emulator executes the full API and worker paths under deny-by-default egress; deterministic fixtures cover success, auth, status, rate-limit, redirect and transport failures

Classify exact content-api-sandbox, marketplace-api-sandbox and supplies-api-sandbox hosts as sandbox; Test token only; Content and Marketplace max 1 rps total, Supplies FBW max 1 rps per method; no sandbox request is authorized by this task
Engineer lookup uses request_ref and opaque local refs; reader roles, retention and lookup surface require Product/Release contract
Activation remains config-gated until owner-authorized release stages; S03 grants no release authority
Infrastructure logging change has no competitor/operator screen or workflow
